run_onedocker_package: run a OneDocker package executable from a local or S3 repository with configurable timeout and arguments
test_docopt_argument_parsing: test that docopt correctly parses simple and complex CLI arguments for the onedocker runner
test_main_local_execution: test running an executable from a local repository path and verify success exit code
test_main_timeout_handling: test that the onedocker runner exits with timeout code when execution exceeds the specified timeout
gen_opawdl_instance_id: generate a unique OPAWDL workflow instance ID by checking against an existing repository to avoid collisions
